record_title: Exact cubic counterterm cancels the full second-order phase correction in a Stuart–Landau triad
provenance: Exact resonant-cubic phase projection applied to the published second-order Stuart–Landau triad phase reduction, with an explicit physical counterterm.
limitations: Perturbative cancellation through order epsilon^2 only. No bound on the order-epsilon^3 remainder or experimental realizability is claimed. The explicit formula uses the source's three-oscillator, straight-isochrone, c=-1, d=0 setting.
